def fn(t0, t1, ta, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t1.view(torch.int32)
    v2 = t0.unfold(0, 1, 1)
    v3 = torch.select_scatter(t1, t0.select(0, 0), 0, 0)
    v4 = v1.reshape((48,))
    v5 = v2[1, :, -1]
    v4.add_(-1)
    idx6 = torch.tensor([6, 3, 1], device=t1.device)
    t1.index_copy_(1, idx6, v3.narrow(1, 0, 3))
    return (t1, v3, lst, dct)
